page.layout: One printed page, title page: large title block at top, then a list of contents-style lines in smaller type, then a closing block of two lines at the foot. No margins with text.

main_text.l: Christi in Eucharistia, proposita in col-

page.notes: Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout, so "praesentia", "Poissiaco" and "Argentoratensi" are read from the printed forms. The u/v spelling is normalised in capitals: QVAE, ALIQVOT, VIRORVM and DOCTORVM become QUAE, ALIQUOT, VIRORUM and DOCTORUM. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. The scan shows show-through from the reverse page at the top and right, which is not transcribed.
